title: ShipSight: check a live site after a deploy
description: The eyes-on check of a live site after a deploy. Loads the page in Chromium and WebKit at desktop and phone widths and reports what a client would notice: buttons out of their box or too close, cut text, sideways scroll, broken images, JS errors, failed requests. Screenshot per finding.
